description.value: Mr. Greek Donair Town is a family-run Afghan Mediterranean eatery on busy Granville Street in downtown Vancouver, known for generous portions of donairs, shawarmas, and crispy pistachio baklava made with fresh ingredients. Run by an Afghan family with a warm, community-hub atmosphere, it has earned strong local acclaim for its chicken donairs and attentive service. The high-foot-traffic Granville Street location makes it a convenient meal stop for cyclists passing through downtown Vancouver.
